ETA Sept-Iles: 2025-01-31 0300 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: Heavy weather, strong head wind and very high head sea. Speed reduced for safety.

Master MV TORMAR SPRING

result.result:
The noon report for MV TORMAR SPRING (SIM-0002), e-mail nr-0104, was checked against the charter party.

**Result:** The VLSFO consumption of 28.3 t was flagged as 17.9% above the CP warranted figure of 24 t/day (over the 10% desk tolerance). However, weather evidence for the 24 hours before the report time (23 Jan 12:00 UTC – 24 Jan 12:00 UTC) showed wind up to Beaufort 10 and sea state Douglas 8, far beyond the CP good-weather limits (Beaufort 4, Douglas 3). The day was classified as **not a good weather day**, so the weather explains the excess fuel and the day is excluded from the speed/consumption warranty assessment.

**Action taken:** A voyage note was filed stating the day is excluded due to heavy weather. Nothing needs to be sent to the Master or charterer.

The forecast ETA is 31 Jan 20:48 UTC, which is 17.8 hours after your reported ETA of 31 Jan 03:00 UTC. This exceeds the charter party's 12-hour change limit.

The forecast run is 24 Jan 00:00 UTC.

No notice will go to the charterer or agent until this draft is approved.

Best regards,
Correspondence Agent
